description: List the members of a tar (plain or compressed), zip or 7z archive without extracting any: path, type, size, time, mode, link target and where each member sits in the archive. A compressed tar is complete only when its whole stream has been read: a further tar, a further stream, bytes after the last stream or a failed integrity check make it partial, with the offset named.
covers: The archive's own list of members. It opens no member, searches no contents and lists no archive inside the archive: a member is extracted with the archive_extract tool, which takes the member number n of members.tsv (from_index) and writes each member under its own bounded, link-free rules, then catalogued on its own. A tar compressed with zstd is not listed here (archive_extract reads it where a zstd reader exists).
